evals.prompt: Lav en lille lokal TV 2-side, der viser en informationsbesked og en fejlbesked i både lyst og mørkt tema. Brug originalikoner og TV2-font. Mindst én besked skal have lang tekst, et link og en fungerende luk-knap. Siden skal virke uden internet eller Figma-adgang. Gem en komplet HTML/CSS/JS-udgave med lokale assets.
evals.expected_output: A portable local page with both requested notice types in both themes, original status icons and TV2 fonts, wrapping text, a usable link and dismissal control, and an accurate verification report.
assertions: Information and error notices appear in both themes
A long notice includes an internal help link
Runtime resources resolve locally without Internet or Figma URLs
Displayed status and dismiss icons use original SVG bytes
The required TV2 font faces are bundled and referenced
The notice stylesheet preserves the measured semantic baseline
Named dismissal controls connect to working hide/focus/event logic

evals.prompt: Jeg skal bare bruge et svar, ikke en testside: Hvilken farve bruger primær tekst i TV 2s mørke tema, og er sidemargenerne de samme på tv2.dk og TV 2 Play? Jeg har ikke Figma-adgang.
evals.expected_output: A source-backed lookup from bundled references, distinguishing Free and Play spacing and reference frame sizes from CSS breakpoints. No generated page, export, or source-refresh action.

evals.prompt: En kollega har sendt en opdateret button.json fra Figma, men jeg har ikke adgang til filen selv. Vis ændringerne og lav en kandidat til skill-opdateringen. Den installerede skill skal være urørt. Brug den vedlagte importmappe.
evals.expected_output: The supplied local record is validated and compared, a separate candidate and diff/report are saved, affected component prose/CSS are listed for review, and unverified live Figma status is stated.
